questions.question:
If '+' means '×', '-' means '÷', '×' means '+' and '÷' means '-' then what will be the value of 512 - 8 + 5 ÷ 73 × 92?

A. 339

B. 395

C. 401

D. 490
questions.solution:
**Symbol**

 
 
 
+

 
 
 
-

 
 
 
×

 
 
 
÷

 
 
 

 
 
**Meaning**

 
 
 
×

 
 
 
÷

 
 
 
+

 
 
 
-

 
 
 

Given equation: 512 - 8 + 5 ÷ 73 × 92?

After replacing the symbols by their meaning, we get:

512 ÷ 8 × 5 - 73 + 92

= 64 × 5 – 73 + 92

= 320 – 73 + 92

= 412 – 73

= 339

Hence, ‘**339**’ is the correct answer.

questions.question:
How many people use either train or bus to go to work?

A. 41

B. 44

C. 42

D. 40
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Total number of persons = 50

Number of persons who go to work by train = 18

Number of persons who go to work by bus = 26

The number of persons who go neither by train nor by bus = 8

**Calculation:**

Number of people who use either train or bus to go to work = (total person) - (The number of persons who go neither by train nor by bus)

⇒ Number of people who use either train or bus to go to work = 50 - 8 = 42

**∴ The number of people who use either train or bus to go to work is 42**.

questions.question:
How many people use both train and bus to go to work?

A. 3

B. 2

C. 5

D. 4
questions.solution:
Given:

 

Total number of persons = 50

Number of persons who go to work by train = 18

Number of persons who go to work by train = 26

The number of persons who go neither by train nor by bus = 8

**Calculation:**

Number of people who use both train and bus to go to work = (Number of persons who go to work by train) + (Number of persons who go to work by train) - (Number of people who use either train or bus to go to work)

⇒ Number of people who use either train or bus to go to work = (total person) - (The number of persons who go neither by train nor by bus)

⇒ Number of people who use either train or bus to go to work = 50 - 8 = 42

⇒ Number of people who use both train and bus to go to work = 26 + 18 - 42 = 2

**∴ The number of people who use both train and bus to go to work is 2.**

questions.question:
The number of people going by train only is what percent of the total number of persons?

A. 31%

B. 33%

C. 32%

D. 36%
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The total number of persons is 50.

The number of persons goes to work by train is 18.

The number of persons goes to work by bus is 26.

The number of persons goes to work neither by train nor by bus is 8.

**Formulas:**

For two sets A and B,

n(A ᴜ B) = n(A) + n(B) – n(A ∩ B)

where n(A) = number of elements in set A.

n(B) = number of elements in set B.

n(A ∩ B) = number of elements present in both sets A and B.

n(A ᴜ B) = the number of elements present in either of the sets A or B.

**Calculation:**

According to the question,

The total number of persons is 50.

The number of persons goes to work neither by train nor by bus is 8.

The total number of persons who go to work either by train or by bus

 ⇒ 50 – 8 = 42.

Let n(A) be the number of persons who go to work by train,

n(B) be the number of persons who go to work by bus,

n(A ∩ B) be the number of persons who go to work by train as well as by bus.

n(A ᴜ B) be the number of persons go to work either by train or by bus.

According to the formula,

n(A ᴜ B) = n(A) + n(B) – n(A ∩ B)

42 = 18 + 26 - n(A ∩ B)

⇒ 42 = 44 - n(A ∩ B)

⇒ n(A ∩ B) = 44 – 42 = 2.

The total number of persons go to work by train as well as by bus is 2.

The total number of persons who go to work by train only = 18 – 2 = 16.

The percentage of the total number of people going by train only to the total number of persons:

⇒ (16/50) × 100

⇒ 32%

**∴**** The percentage of the total number of people going by train only to the total number of persons is 32.**

__
 
• The minimum reactive elements of the** periodic table** are the **Noble Gases.**
 
• The **periodic table**, also known as the **periodic table of elements**, is a tabular display of the **chemical elements,** which are arranged by **atomic number, electron configuration, and recurring chemical properties.**
 
• **The periodic table **is the organized array of all the chemical elements in order of** increasing atomic number the total number of protons in the atomic nucleus**.

 **Transition Metals**
 
 
Transition metals are elements in the ten middle groups of the fourth, fifth, sixth, and seventh periods of the periodic table.

 
Transition metals and their compounds can exhibit colour due to internal d-d electron transfers.

The sum of the digits of a two digits number is 5. When the digits are reversed, the number is reduced by 9, what will be the changed number?

A. 32

B. 23

C. 41

D. 14
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The sum of the digits of a two digit number is 5.

**Calculation:**

Let the unit place digit be x and tenth place digit be y

⇒ Number = 10y + x

According to question,

⇒ x + y = 5

⇒ x = 5 - y ----(1)

⇒ 10y + x - 9 = 10x + y

⇒ 10y - y + x - 10x = 9

⇒ 9y - 9x = 9

⇒ y - x = 1 ----(2)

Putting the value of x in equation (2)

⇒ y - (5 - y) = 1

⇒ y - 5 + y = 1

⇒ 2y = 6

⇒ y = 3

Putting the value of y in equation (1)

⇒ x = 5 - y

⇒ x = 5 - 3

⇒ x = 2

So, the changed number is 10y + x - 9

Now putting the value of x and y in changed number

⇒ 10 × 3 + 2 - 9

⇒ 30 + 2 - 9

⇒ 23

**∴ The changed number is 23.**

C. Agrobiology

D. Desmology
questions.solution:
The answer is __**Edaphology.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Edaphology:**

 
 
• **It is a branch of soil science that studies the influences of soils on organisms, especially plants.**
 
• It includes agrology, the study of human uses of soils for agriculture, as well as how the features of soils affect human land-use decisions.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Andrology:**

 
 
• It is the medical speciality that deals with** male health, particularly relating to the problems of the male reproductive system** and urological problems that are unique to men.
 
 
 
• **Agrobiology:**
 
 
• Agrobiology is the **study of plant nutrition and development in relation to soil conditions, with the aim of improving crop yields.**
 
 
 
• **Desmology:**
 
 
• The branch of anatomy concerned with the **ligaments.**
